mapper.sql:
SELECT m.id AS match_id, partner.id AS user_id, p.nickname, p.gender, TRUNC(MONTHS_BETWEEN(SYSDATE, p.birth_date) / 12) AS age, p.height, p.job, p.region, ( SELECT LISTAGG(i.name, ', ') WITHIN GROUP (ORDER BY i.id) FROM mingle_user_interests ui JOIN mingle_interests i ON i.id = ui.interest_id WHERE ui.user_id = partner.id ) AS interests, photo.photo_url, m.last_message, m.last_message_at, ( SELECT COUNT(*) FROM mingle_chat_messages unread WHERE unread.match_id = m.id AND unread.sender_id != #{userId} AND unread.is_read = 0 ) AS unread_count,
CASE WHEN m.status = 'ACTIVE' THEN 0 ELSE 1 END AS read_only
FROM mingle_matches m
JOIN mingle_users partner ON partner.id = CASE WHEN m.user1_id = #{userId} THEN m.user2_id ELSE m.user1_id END
JOIN mingle_user_profiles p ON p.user_id = partner.id
LEFT JOIN mingle_profile_photos photo ON photo.user_id = partner.id AND photo.is_primary = 1
mapper.select: SELECT COUNT(*) FROM mingle_matches m WHERE (m.user1_id = #{userId} OR m.user2_id = #{userId}) AND ( m.status = 'ACTIVE' OR (m.status = 'CANCELLED' AND m.cancelled_by != #{userId}) )
mapper.insert:
SELECT seq_mingle_matches.NEXTVAL FROM dual
INSERT INTO mingle_matches (id, user1_id, user2_id, status, matched_at) VALUES (#{id}, #{user1Id}, #{user2Id}, 'ACTIVE', SYSDATE)
mapper.select: SELECT CASE WHEN user1_id = #{userId} OR user2_id = #{userId} THEN 1 ELSE 0 END AS participant, CASE WHEN user1_id = #{userId} THEN user2_id ELSE user1_id END AS partnerId, status, cancelled_by AS cancelledBy FROM mingle_matches WHERE id = #{matchId}
mapper.update: UPDATE mingle_matches SET last_message = #{lastMessage, jdbcType=VARCHAR}, last_message_at = SYSDATE WHERE id = #{matchId}
UPDATE mingle_matches SET status = 'CANCELLED', cancelled_by = #{cancelledBy}, cancelled_at = SYSDATE, cancel_reason = #{cancelReason, jdbcType=VARCHAR} WHERE id = #{matchId} AND status = 'ACTIVE'
UPDATE mingle_matches SET status = 'DESTROYED' WHERE id = #{matchId} AND status = 'CANCELLED'
